header: An overall score, then one row per criterion
lead: The scale is five segments, so type 4.5 rather than 90%. The overall score is typed too and is never averaged from the rows — a weighted verdict and an unweighted mean are different numbers, and the note is where you say which this is.
note: Use Progress Bars when the rows are percentages of completion, and Distribution Bars when you are showing how many people gave each rating.

metrics.title: A half row
metrics.text: Four solid and one at half — the fraction is drawn, not rounded away.

metrics.title: An unrated row
metrics.text: Nothing typed leaves five empty segments.
